excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出那颗恒星周围确实环行着另一个与未叙尊者的神龛别无二致的物体。
excerpt.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system. Its crew reports the star is indeed orbited by another object not dissimilar to the shrine of the Untold.

triggers.en: When a fleet enters a system

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]已经进入了[Root.GetStarName]星系。船员报告指出那颗恒星周围确实环行着另一个与未叙尊者的神龛别无二致的物体。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has entered the [Root.GetStarName] system. Its crew reports the star is indeed orbited by another object not dissimilar to the shrine of the Untold.

texts.zh:
恩赐女神神龛的每一面上都覆盖着由的象形文字组成的复杂网络，似乎在诉说着一个远比[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]的上古传说更加恢弘的故事。

即使只是与已知的古[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]语言有着些许的关系，只要有足够的时间和资源，在当代科技的帮助下，我们也可以解读这些象形文字。
texts.en:
Every surface of the Benefactress' shrine is covered with a complex web of pictograms, seemingly telling a story far more expansive than the lingering fables on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName].

Though only distantly related to known ancient [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] languages: modern technology should allow us to decipher the pictograms, given enough time and resources.

title.en: Old Gods: Shrine to the Benefactress

texts.zh:
破解恩赐女神神殿中的象形文字要比预计的顺利许多。负责该项目的语言学家们称，这些文本莫名地令人亲切：能轻易地“触动”他们的心弦，尽管其中的语法古老又冗杂。

然而，他们指出，这些信息暗示了一些非常晦涩难懂的主题和上下文。我们除非与关于这位四位一体的神的其他文本结合起来，否则很难完全理解他们的信息。
texts.en:
Deciphering the pictograms in the Benefactress' shrine went more smoothly than anticipated. The linguists assigned to the project describe these texts as somehow familiar: "clicking" easily for them, despite the grammar's age and complexity.

They note, however, these written messages allude to some truly obscure themes and contexts. We cannot fully understand their messages until they are combined with other texts associated with this quadrumvirate godhead.

texts.zh:
完整的众神教条——因为我们认为被恢复的文本就应该被这样视作——对我们具有启示意义，它对于我们古老宗教赖以建立的那些幻想基础是具有毁灭性的。

当放在以[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]为中心的情景中时，这些文本清楚地表明，我们注定要在一位宗教领袖强有力的手段的引导下实现伟大的功业。我们注定要成为神，但我们的过去充斥着流产的预言和因无知而产生的罪恶。救赎是短暂的。
texts.en:
The complete doctrine of the gods - for that is how we believe the recovered texts should be regarded - is as revelatory to us as it is devastating to the fantasies upon which our ancient religions were founded.

When placed within a [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]-centered context, these texts make it clear that we were meant for greatness, guided by the strong hand of a religious leader. We are destined for godhood, but our past is littered with unfulfilled prophecies and sin born of ignorance. Redemption is ephemeral.

tooltips.zh: 知识就是力量。神秘的知识是神秘的力量。
tooltips.en: Knowledge is power. Secret knowledge is secret power.

label.zh: 我们可以拿这个换点钱。
但是我们能从中了解到什么？
label.en: But what can we learn from this?

label.zh: 我们追随神意的脚步前进！
label.en: We walk in the footsteps of the Divine!
